description: 静岡市消防局 給油取扱所一覧 [fire, police and emergency services] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 静岡市. 静岡市消防局管轄内で、登録されている給油取扱所の一覧表です。 施設区分、施設詳細、施設名称、設置場所住所が分かります。. Coverage: 静岡市. The portal files it under the publisher 静岡市. Its tags are ガソリン, 一覧, 危険物, 危険物施設. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-09-09 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
